clue.text: Starting to colour black bird yellow

parts.note: the raven is a large all-black bird

explanation.definitionFit: Yellow is slang for cowardly, and craven is a synonym meaning lacking courage.

clue.text: Celestial 19 across gutted by war god

clue.text: Insubordinate unit sumo wrestling

clue.text: "Airplane" conceals source of sick joke

indicators.note: the source of the word sick is its first letter

explanation.walkthrough: Airplane! is a famously silly film comedy, which suits the surface.

clue.text: Traveller from 19 across returned, unexcited about P&O

the second letter of the shipping line's initials

clue.text: Make-up requiring slight adjustment of Palin's going self-description

explanation.walkthrough: 'slight adjustment of' swaps letters of ROGUE. Sarah Palin, the US politician, called her memoir Going Rogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Red cosmetic powder for the cheeks is a classic form of facial cosmetics.

clue.text: Sod bringing poet round on time

parts.note: Ovid was the Roman poet

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sod' looks like a mild curse, but it is a noun for a piece of turf.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of turf gouged out by a golf club is a chunk of grassy earth.

clue.text: Kick ass that's not very well put together

something improvised and crudely assembled as a stopgap

explanation.definitionFit: A temporary, improvised substitute is roughly cobbled from whatever lies to hand.

clue.text: Satisfied with what's included

definitions.meaning: happy and pleased with one's lot
the material contained within something, such as a book or box

clue.text: Holidaymaker wanting male bud

explanation.definitionFit: The pickled flower bud of a Mediterranean shrub is used as a savoury seasoning.

clue.text: Alphabetical step forward at end of ugly lair

indicators.text: Alphabetical step forward at end of

parts.note: hideous means very ugly

explanation.walkthrough: The final S of HIDEOUS steps forward one letter to T.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret refuge where fugitives shelter is a den or retreat.

clue.text: Musician suffering blues so bad

explanation.surface: A player with the blues, feeling terrible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffering' rearranges BLUESSOBAD. The instrument's name stands for its player, as orchestras do.
explanation.definitionFit: In an orchestra the player of the largest string instrument is called by the instrument's name.

clue.text: Bird with an impressive figure

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A bird with an imposing shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A giant of mythology, the word now means anyone of towering stature or importance.

clue.text: Analyse quiet bum

parts.note: P stands for piano, quiet in music
bum and arse are both British slang for the backside

explanation.surface: Examining a silent backside.

clue.text: Regulation about lifting quote from handbag

clue.text: Male's setback

indicators.note: read back means read in the reverse direction

parts.note: to put something is to set it down

explanation.surface: A man's reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: A ram, the male of the sheep, goes by this regional farming name.

clue.text: Stain from transmutation of Turin etc

explanation.surface: A mark left by changes to the Turin Shroud and so on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transmutation of' rearranges TURINETC.
explanation.definitionFit: A dye or tint colouring something is a colouring agent, and in heraldry a colour.

clue.text: Distressed by cheerful performance

parts.note: up means in good spirits
a set is a musician's performance

explanation.surface: Upset by an upbeat show.
explanation.definitionFit: Being troubled or agitated is the emotional sense of the past participle.

clue.text: Got back to headless monster about anticipated showtime?

headless loses the first letter

parts.note: the kraken is a legendary sea monster
intended as the abbreviation for estimated time of arrival, the expected moment

explanation.walkthrough: The setter meant ETA, estimated time of arrival, but that leaves a spare A; only the first two letters fit, as Shed admitted.

clue.text: European wanting one to embrace black movement

explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting' drops I from ITALIAN to give TALIAN; 'to embrace' puts B inside.

clue.text: Motor's given its heart to fish

parts.note: a turbo is a turbocharged engine or car

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letter

explanation.surface: A car's engine giving its heart for a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A large European flatfish prized as food.

clue.text: Poll tax initially following two things round

parts.note: a ball is a round thing
the letter O is round in shape

indicators.note: initially takes just the first letter

explanation.walkthrough: Poll tax was a controversial British local tax.

clue.text: It moves passengers to get a real cost analysis

indicators.note: analysis breaks something down, so these letters are broken up and reordered

clue.text: Reproduction of speech overheard

indicators.note: short means missing its last letter

parts.note: lolly is British slang for money

explanation.surface: Looking relaxed despite being hard up.

clue.text: Lump or layabout holding university back

clue.text: Reportedly look for subscriber to faith

parts.note: a hall of residence houses students
A means one
